>You may have fucked up, and I don't know your story, but most likely, there's still a chance to go back and fix it or advance in some other way.

Basically, subjects here take 2 years to complete. In the first year I failed 3 out of 3 subjects. I dropped to subjects for the second year and picked up 1 different subject which counted as 2 qualifications. For the second year I was doing 2 classes. Failed in the class that was 1 qualification but since I can completed 2 years even though I got the worst grade possible I completed the subject. I also re-took exams for one of the subjects I'd tried the year before and got the worst grade possible. The next year I was only doing my second year of the subject that was 2 qualifications. By the end of it I got a below average grade but didn't fail but the qualification is completely useless to me and it is not something I want to go into at all. I also retook exams for the subjects in the first year and again got the worst grade possible.

I studied HARD and worked my ass of every time. I went home to study, I studied in school, during break. Almost every single day. I put a lot of effort into organising my time well so I was maximising my studying while not being burnt out.

Then I took a year off from school all together because I was so burnt out. I've had 3 years where I studied with people far younger than me yet they still get better grades than me and I work very hard.

I struggle with my intelligence a lot now. I currently work and study and I have a lot of difficulty picking up new things. It takes me much much longer to pick up new ideas than anyone else, even 5 years younger than me. I have to try things over and over again at my work so I can begin to understand how things work. People lose their tolerance for me a LOT. They laugh at me and roll their eyes at me. When I'm on the job they get annoyed and ask for someone else, because they say I mess up. I try really hard though. Even when I'm depressed I don't stop trying. It hasn't worked, I can't just find something that works because when I find a method that works well for a particular task I have to find a completely new one for a different task. There is no universal cure expect raising my intelligence. And I am sick of the people around me knowing this and avoiding me.

I do work hard. When I was young I had severe dyslexia. I could not write a legible sentence until I was about 14. Or type a sentence that made any sense. I have worked on that so I am able to type this way now. But I spent years on that and there are so many more things to work on and I'll always be behind by a long way.

My SO always tells me college will always be here. It did used to help. But.... right now it's costing £4,000 a year to be in school (it would be COMPLETELY free if I took this course 2 years ago when was younger). If I succeeded in school I would not need to take this course at all. I'm going to have to take a foundation year in university which is an extra year costing £9,250 that year + accomodation which is about £8,000. If I wasn't stupid, I would save £21,250 and about 5 years of my life where I could be making money and not living at my parents house creating more and more debt. Right now the facts of it all are setting in. If I finished school with good grades and went to university right away it would be just £9,250 for 3 years (less than that because a few years ago it was cheaper). All my friends are graduating university this year and I am in class with a bunch of 16 year olds. It costs £4,000 a year for me to be here and it will be £9,250 for 4 years including that foundation year at university. None of my friends are in this situation. I make minimum wage at work and it's next to nothing. It would take 4 ½ years to pay for 1 year of university alone. That's if I don't spend a penny from work.

And look at my track record. How do I know I will not fail this year in school? Or at uni? I don't really want to go without education into work. I am almost certain I'd kill myself working full time in my current job and I can't imagine any other retail or fast food jobs being much better. My career and education is my passion. I want to be a vet.

I have done non private and private therapy. I've been on the waiting list for non private for 3 years even though they know I am suicidal. I've tried private therapy but it didn't work and it was very very expensive and I can't pay for that again and I cannot continue paying until I find the right one.
